# netactuate_bgp_sessions (Data Source)

Reads BGP Sessions visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_bgp_sessions" "example" {
  mbpkgid = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) Package ID assigned by the API.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `sessions` (List of Object) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sessions))
